rules.title: No real personal data in code
rules.text: Never put real customer or personal data in code, tests, fixtures, commits or pull requests; use synthetic examples such as user@example.com.

rules.title: Collect minimal data
rules.text: Collect and store only the personal data a feature needs.

rules.title: Define retention
rules.text: Define retention and deletion for every store of personal data.

rules.title: Encrypt sensitive data
rules.text: Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest.

rules.title: Honor consent
rules.text: Check consent and opt-out settings before analytics or marketing processing.

rules.title: Synthetic test data
rules.text: Generate test data with factories; never copy production data into non-production environments.
